rule: Goal: $2,200 (+10% on $2,000) by the 11/18 close, and beat SPY buy-and-hold with the same money over the same window.
Window: fills from Mon 10/19 to the Wed 11/18 close, on NYSE sessions only.
Real money only in the Robinhood agent account (nickname MCP, ending 5318). The paper ledger runs alongside as the shadow model.
Options only, buying only: buy to open calls or puts, sell to close. Never sell to open, never multi-leg, never exercise. Stock and ETF buys are switched off.
source: Owner 10/17; enforced by tracker.py and live.py

rule: Never deposits, withdrawals, transfers, account-setting changes, crypto, margin or shorting. Never touch the owner's other holdings or accounts.
At most $2,000 of real money at work. The loss-limit stop trips only if all $2,000 is lost.
At most 4 fills a day, no same-day round trips, no second fill in one ticker on a day, at most 4 open positions, never average down.
source: RULES.md; enforced by tracker.py and live.py

rule: Every real order needs a live.py gate ticket: confirmed by the pre-close run that day before 15:50 ET, placed as a limit order at the broker's live quote, one ticket per order.
Kill switch: a KILL_SWITCH file (or the owner's word) stops all orders. Only the owner removes it.

Conflict guardrail: every persona is Claude, built by Anthropic. No trade whose thesis is Anthropic or its IPO. GOOGL, AMZN, MSFT, AVGO and NVDA ideas use public facts only, and the link is disclosed.
The whole $2,000 is the budget: no cash floor and no single-order cap. The whole $2,000 can be lost.
source: Owner 10/30: "Remove caps on place a buy. You have 2 k to work with"

rule: Each order's thesis states its size and why, with Kelly sizing from a tested payoff distribution (sizing.py): full, half and quarter Kelly, planned at half-Kelly.
Buy one contract only when full Kelly covers its cost; otherwise no trade.
Theme caps at cost: AI/semis at most 40% of equity, energy at most 40%. Leveraged or inverse ETFs at most $300 each.
At most one new shot a day. Doing nothing is a valid trade.
Liquid US stocks and ETFs only. Open interest at least 1,000 at the strike; spread at most 5% of the mid (10% for commodity or sector ETFs such as USO).
Delta 0.30-0.45, never below 0.25. Expiry 2-5 weeks out; no entry within 3 days of expiry; every option is sold at least one session before it expires.
Event premium: buy only at the print day's 14:43 decision, only if the implied move is at most 0.9x the median of recent reactions, and sell at the next day's decision.
An edge figure counts only if it comes from a committed script or a cited published study.

Retired arguments (may not be cited): the midterm-window rally, the Halloween effect, the turn of the month, RSI(2) dips, a follow-through day as an edge, "IV is low", the pre-earnings run-up through calls, FINRA short-volume spikes, Wikipedia attention, the put/call ratio.
Consensus check: every proposal says what a generic AI would recommend. A match needs a measured edge.
Prediction-market odds are an input to the macro brief, not a trading signal.

C1, the one confirmed setup: a mega-cap down gap of 8% or more vs the pre-print close at the reaction day's 14:43 check. Buy 1 put at delta 0.30-0.45 with IV at most 1.3x the pre-print 20-day realized vol, spread at most 5%, OI at least 1,000, expiry at least 14 days, sized by Kelly at the contract's days to expiry. No market gates (provisional).

Goal-budget variance bet: pre-registered 11/02 for one entry on 11/04 (1 SPY call, delta 0.35-0.40, at most $850, -50% stop). It was used and stopped out on 11/05. No re-entry without a new pre-registered rule, goal odds on live quotes and a red-team; the Sunday 11/08 review decides.
source: Claude under the owner's autonomy grant 11/02; playbook.md

rule: The exit plan is written at entry. One contract sells all at +50%; two or more sell half at +50% and the rest at +100%, as a resting GTC limit at the broker from the evening of the buy. The stop moves to cost after a 14:43 check shows +40%.
Stops sit at the underlying level where the thesis is wrong, with a -50% premium backstop. They are checked at the 14:43 check, and a breached stop sells the same day.
C1 puts: hold 5 sessions (time exit), with the -50% backstop; no take-profit and no resting GTC.
Goal-budget exception: the resting GTC sits at the $2,200-equity price (at least 1.4x cost) instead of +50%. No resting stop orders on options (gap risk).
Evening and Sunday runs write proposals only. The 14:43 pre-close run re-decides everything on fresh quotes and confirms, cancels or adds before 15:50 ET; anything unconfirmed does not fill.
The pre-open run checks news only: it may cancel or add proposals, but never confirms or places an order.
Buys of 20% of equity or more (or any leveraged ETF) need a fresh risk red-team first; every draft proposal from the evening run is red-teamed.
Prices come from quotes.py (two providers within 0.3%) or the broker's live quote; the AI never types a price. A close that cannot be verified skips the order.
The ledger, marks and journal are append-only; corrections are dated journal notes. Every order carries a written thesis and every fill a price source.
Breaking a soft guardrail needs a dated journal entry that names the rule and why.
Check stops during the day (about 10:00 and 12:00 ET as well as 14:43), or rest a stop-limit with a floor, on any open option.
Entry checklist: "Who loses from today's driver, and how much of the underlying do they weigh?"
Size so that a 75%+ loss on day 1 still leaves the goal reachable; treat model tails as optimistic after event days.
